classification.rationale: Transcribed YouTube interview/documentary featuring Luis Elizondo; contains witness testimony (Maurice Hill) and historical references, but primary framing is media production.

_raw_list: Luis Elizondo claims the existence of American Legacy UFO reverse engineering programs and of non-human intelligence.
Elizondo claims there is an 'absolute connection' between UAP and nuclear capabilities, and that it is 'unequivocal'.
Elizondo claims he handled an implant removed from a US veteran by the Department of Veterans Affairs, which was 'moving under the microscope under its own metabolism'.
Elizondo claims that Dr. Wernher von Braun showed him a piece of metal from a crashed UFO, saying 'this is a piece of a UFO that crashed on our planet'.
Elizondo claims he worked with David Grusch in the 'Ski' (likely referring to a special access program or compartment), and that Grusch 'knows a lot more even than he was allowed to say'.
Elizondo claims that the external part of UAP craft may be 'ablative sacrificial', and that the energy source interaction with the craft's exterior creates a 'bubble' effect.
Elizondo claims that UAP are interested in observing military capabilities, comparing it to watching cheetahs hunt antelope.

Elizondo claims that the 1952 Washington DC flyover involved fighter jets scrambled to intercept, and there are unverified allegations they were asked to fire upon and may have hit one of the objects.
Elizondo claims that the dissemination of information about UAP 'now exists in a way that it cannot be controlled'.
Elizondo claims that the fact 'we are not alone in this universe' does not necessarily need to be classified.
